## FAQ: Tesla Optimus Production Timeline
What is Tesla's Optimus production target for 2026?

Tesla's stated target is 50,000–100,000 units in 2026, with Fremont targeting 1 million units/year run-rate capacity by year-end. Treat 2026 targets as aspirational pending Q2–Q3 disclosure.
